description: Operations that declare `idempotent: true` with no replay evidence. Every entry is ONE operation with an owner and a review date — there is no wildcard and no module-wide waiver, because a class-wide suppression would hide the next one silently, which is exactly what this check exists to prevent. A NEW unproven promise fails the gate immediately.
context: Found by scripts/ci/check-idempotency-evidence.mjs on its first run against the P1-21 baseline. All ten predate this initiative: they are IAM and organisation-settings operations delivered in P1-14, and the operation-test matrix confirms none of them has a derived `idempotency` evidence category. `idempotent: true` is a promise to the caller that a retry will not double-write state, audit or outbox. Whether the CODE honours that promise is a P1-14 question and cannot be settled by a CI initiative — writing the tests blind would either pass vacuously or turn into unscoped business-logic remediation. They are therefore recorded by name, surfaced in the closure report, and time-boxed.
reviewByRationale: 2026-10-31 is the end of the quarter following this initiative, which is enough time for a dedicated remediation change and short enough that the list cannot quietly become permanent.
